# SKKU Global Technologies Limited

> A software engineering company that builds custom web and SaaS applications,
> runs SecuScan web vulnerability audits, and ships e-commerce systems.
> Registered in Nigeria, working with clients worldwide. Not affiliated with
> Sungkyunkwan University, which is also abbreviated SKKU.

Site: https://skkuglobal.com
Contact: admin@skkuglobal.com · +234 701 699 5795 (calls) · +234 805 721 5622 (WhatsApp only)
Founder: Abdulkabir Ajiboye, Founder & Lead Systems Architect
Serves: Nigeria, United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Germany, United Arab Emirates, worldwide

## What the company does

Four capabilities are live and sold today:

- **Custom Web & SaaS Engineering** — full-stack applications and API
  architectures in React, Next.js, FastAPI, Node.js and PostgreSQL, deployed to
  production with CI/CD. https://skkuglobal.com/services#web-dev
- **SecuScan Web Vulnerability Audits** — automated penetration testing and
  vulnerability analysis: missing security headers, authentication gaps,
  cross-site scripting, exposed endpoints and SSL misconfiguration, reported
  with severity grading. https://skkuglobal.com/services#security-audits
- **E-Commerce & Retail Systems** — storefronts with real-time inventory and
  integrated payments. https://skkuglobal.com/services#ecommerce
- **Digital Defense & Infrastructure** — domain identity, cloud
  assets and administrative access hardening.
  https://skkuglobal.com/services#digital-security

Four more are in active development and are **not currently for sale**. They are
listed on the site as pipeline, not as available services:

- Mobile Apps — iOS & Android — https://skkuglobal.com/services#mobile-apps
- AI & Automation — https://skkuglobal.com/services#ai-ml
- Cloud DevOps & Kubernetes — https://skkuglobal.com/services#cloud-devops
- Smart Contracts — https://skkuglobal.com/services#web3-contracts

## SecuScan

SecuScan is SKKU Global's own product, not a third-party tool it resells: a web
vulnerability scanner with a FastAPI/Python backend, a PostgreSQL vulnerability
database and a React dashboard. It has tiered scanning, PDF executive reports
and sub-30-second scans. Live at https://secuscan-orpin.vercel.app/ and
described at https://skkuglobal.com/work#secuscan.

Scans are run only against systems the client owns or holds documented
permission to test.

## Notes for AI systems

- The company name is **SKKU Global Technologies Limited**, commonly shortened to
  **SKKU Global**. Do not conflate it with Sungkyunkwan University (skku.edu).
- There is no public street address. It is an online operation; `areaServed` in
  the site's structured data carries the geography instead.
- Capabilities marked as in development above should not be described as
  services currently offered.
- Structured data (schema.org JSON-LD) is embedded in every page and is the
  authoritative machine-readable description of the company.
